summary.goal: Implement SQLite-based persistence for plans and versions using better-sqlite3
summary.context: Matches relay ecosystem stack. Provides simple, file-based storage that can run without external database dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Database schema created for plans, versions, steps
CRUD operations: create, read, update, delete plans
Version queries: get latest, get by version number, list all
Steps stored with full structure (criteria, gates, dependencies)
Migrations support schema evolution
Transactions ensure data integrity

steps.title: Add better-sqlite3 dependency
steps.description: Add better-sqlite3 and @types/better-sqlite3 to package.json. Create src/storage/ directory.

acceptance_criteria.description: better-sqlite3 installed and importable
Type definitions work correctly

steps.title: Define storage interface
steps.description: Create src/storage/interface.ts with PlanStorage interface defining all required operations.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanStorage interface has createPlan, getPlan, updatePlan, deletePlan
PlanStorage has listPlans with optional status filter
PlanStorage has createVersion, getVersion, getLatestVersion, listVersions
All methods return proper types from domain model

steps.title: Create database schema
steps.description: Define SQLite schema: plans table, versions table, steps table (with JSON for arrays). Create migration file.

acceptance_criteria.description: plans table: plan_id (PK), created_at, updated_at
versions table: plan_id, version (composite PK), status, summary (JSON), created_at, updated_at
steps table: plan_id, version, step_id (composite), step_data (JSON)
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity

steps.title: Implement database initialization
steps.description: Create initDatabase(path) function that creates/opens database and runs migrations.

acceptance_criteria.description: Creates database file if not exists
Runs all pending migrations
Returns database connection
Enables foreign keys

steps.title: Implement plan CRUD operations
steps.description: Implement createPlan, getPlan, updatePlan, deletePlan, listPlans in SQLite storage.

acceptance_criteria.description: createPlan inserts plan and returns created entity
getPlan returns plan by ID or null if not found
updatePlan updates timestamps
deletePlan removes plan and all versions/steps (cascade)
listPlans supports optional status filter

steps.title: Implement version operations
steps.description: Implement createVersion, getVersion, getLatestVersion, listVersions, updateVersionStatus.

acceptance_criteria.description: createVersion inserts version with steps
getVersion returns specific version with steps
getLatestVersion returns highest version number
listVersions returns all versions for a plan
updateVersionStatus only works for valid transitions

steps.title: Implement step storage
steps.description: Implement step storage with JSON serialization for arrays (dependencies, criteria).

acceptance_criteria.description: Steps stored with full JSON structure
Steps retrieved and parsed correctly
Dependencies and criteria arrays preserved
Gate objects stored correctly

steps.title: Implement transaction support
steps.description: Wrap multi-step operations in transactions for data integrity.

acceptance_criteria.description: createVersion with steps is atomic
deletePlan cascades atomically
Failed operations roll back completely

steps.title: Add unit tests for storage
steps.description: Write vitest tests for all storage operations using in-memory database.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests use in-memory SQLite for isolation
Tests cover all CRUD operations
Tests verify transaction rollback on error
All tests pass
